### 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is.  
*Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."*

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### 🔄 Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### 🎨 UI / UX Concept (Optional)
If you have mockups, sketches, or examples of how this could look or behave, please attach them here.

### 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, references, or use cases about the feature request here.
